The '''Interplanetary Component Exchange''' was market listing service during the time of the [[Old Republic era|Old Republic]]. Growing from a basic database service for [[Starship/Legends|starship]] mechanics, the exchange became a notorious place for trading military grade equipment, weapons and supply for the criminal underground. Virtually undetected by authorities of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the service even offered entire [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] as items for sale.

==Behind the scenes==
The Interplanetary Component Exchange appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as the Reputation faction for the Starfighter Packs on the Cartel Market.
